text_to_speech: so hi uh so firstly i would like to congratulate exchange for media that in spite of all these challenges because of the pandemic uh they managed to organize this event and it was very well organized so congratulations and i'm not surprised you received more than thousand entries um you know with this pandemic all businesses move towards digital marketing but the good thing is that the quality of the entries was also very good in a group you know we were really struggling to just shortlist three and we nominated more than one in multiple categories our decision was based on the innovative content and of course the roi that was the key decision making factor so congratulations to all the winners um i think it was well deserved by all of you and i also say that was a big learning experience for me you know with digital marketing everyone is now learning on the job there is no precedence to things uh these days so it was a good learning experience so thank you for having me for this process thank you bye

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: So firstly I would like to congratulate Exchange for Media that in spite of all these challenges because of the pandemic
they managed to organize this event and it was very well organized. So congratulations.
And I'm not surprised you received more than 1000 entries.
You know with this pandemic all businesses move towards digital marketing.
But the good thing is that the quality of the entries was also very good.
In a group you know we were really struggling to just short list three and we nominated more than one in multiple categories.
Our decision was based on the innovative content and of course the ROI that was the key decision making factor.
So congratulations to all the winners. I think it was well deserved by all of you.
And also say that was a big learning experience for me.
You know with digital marketing everyone is now learning on the job. There is no precedence to things these days.
So it was a good learning experience. So thank you for having me for this process.
